bio: What is it that draws regulars and day trippers here in equal numbers? The richly decorated space is wonderfully rustic and the remarkable collection of farm machinery is well worth seeing. Classic international and regional dishes such as Böfflamott (beef in red wine), rooster burger and saddle of lamb in a herb crust are served, as well as a seasonal set menu. Three individually decorated double rooms can be booked for overnight stays in the building next door....
